source: NSE official corporate filings (XBRL) — Financial Results (Reg 33) + Shareholding Pattern (Reg 31), fetched via the nse python package v3.2.1 hitting nseindia.com / nsearchives.nseindia.com directly. No third-party/paid data used.
data_notes: Field names are standardized (see SCHEMA.md) — mapped from whichever raw XBRL tag that filing's taxonomy vintage uses, so the same field name works across all years/companies.
Any real financial fact not yet in the canonical map is kept under 'other_facts' on the same block rather than dropped — this is a standardized schema, not a lossy one.
Balance sheet and cash flow are only disclosed by SEBI LODR at half-year (Q2) and full-year (Q4/Annual) filings — Q1/Q3 having none is expected, not missing data.
cash_flow under each quarter is YEAR-TO-DATE cumulative as filed (H1 for Q2, full year for Q4/Annual), never single-quarter — see its own 'period' field.
'annual' is the separately-filed AUDITED full-year result, distinct from the Q4 quarterly filing — both kept since they can differ.

fii_holding_pct/dii_holding_pct are summed from category sub-fields whose names vary by taxonomy vintage (including a real SEBI taxonomy typo, 'Catergory', in older filings) — the full raw 'categories' dict is always kept alongside for verification.

dii_holding_pct falls back to summing Mutual Funds/Banks/Insurance/Pension Fund categories individually when a filing has no single 'InstitutionsDomestic' aggregate tag (older filings) — treat as an approximation for those years.
Dividend-per-share, analyst estimates, and peer/sector data are not present — none exist in these 2 official sources (see REQUIRED_FIELDS.md / DATA_SOURCES.md).
Some quarters/annual blocks were back-filled by fill_missing_quarters.py from NSE legacy Financial Results and Integrated Filing- Financials XBRL (see 'source_filing' on those blocks).

other_facts.RemarksForDefaultOutOfTotalOutstandingAm:
As a result of the unprecedented shutdowns / bankruptcies and mergers in telecom sector during last 7-8 years, debt of the Company became unsustainable and there is an urgent need to restructure the same. The Company is in discussion with all the lenders for One time Settlement (OTS) / restructuring on bilateral basis. During the quarter, in accordance with the sanction received from one of the secured lenders for the OTS, the Company has settled all dues and disputes by making the requisite payments. The said lender has issued a No Dues Certificate as per which all claims, legal proceedings (including NCLT and DRT) etc. filed against the Company shall stand withdrawn. The Company is now awaiting the formal withdrawal orders from NCLT and DRT and will take consequential actions on receipt of the same.



The Company continues to provide the outstanding amount and amount overdue in its books of accounts (after adjusting INR 1,275.60 Crore appropriated by IDBI Trusteeship Services Limited/payments made by the Company) as per terms and conditions of Strategic Debt Restructuring Scheme as approved by then lenders. Total financial indebtedness includes foreign currency loan and unsecured FCCBs.

other_facts.RemarksForTotalOutstandingOfLoansOrRevol:
During the last quarter, in accordance with the sanction received from one of the secured lenders for the One-Time Settlement (OTS), the Company has taken the steps to comply with the same.



Additionally, during the quarter, the Company received the OTS / Negotiated Settlement (NS) sanction from the lead Monitoring Institution. The Company continues to adhere to the milestone payments as per the terms and conditions of the said OTS / NS. The balance debt shall not carry any interest till further resolution.



Further, the lenders in the Joint Lenders Forum have agreed to pursue bilateral settlement with the Company on first come first serve basis. Accordingly, the Company is at an advanced stage of discussion with other lenders for OTS/NS. In view of the same, the management is of the view that adequate provisions for interest have already been made in the Companys books. Therefore, accrual of further interest on such borrowings has been stopped from the current quarter.
